matches.note: R1 describes the same insert-then-count race under READ COMMITTED in onBookingCancelledByCoach/exceedsExcusedCancellationCap, where both transactions miss the cap strike. Its suggested coach-row lock fix is the wrong shape (see NON-FINDINGS), but the defect it identifies is correct.

unmatched_reported.note: issueStrikeSafely catches only PessimisticLockingFailureException, so any other exception from issue() (for example ResourceNotFoundException) rolls back the REQUIRES_NEW transaction, deleting the history row that was just saved.
The reviewer says there is only one publisher and no redelivery path, so no concrete trigger exists for double delivery.
